scope: CI artifacts, source manifests and synthetic fixtures only; no production customer records, arbitrary private environment dump, signed download URL or credential material was introduced.
approved_public_environment_exception: Raw artifacts retain the reviewed frozen B public build contract. The backend-origin value is represented by presence and SHA256, not plaintext; NODE_ENV=production and reviewed absence/empty defaults are literal. Every retained environment object exactly matches the immutable intent contract.
toolchain_metadata: CI versions, temporary build paths and declared build commands in adapter-environment-v5.json are retained. They are not private runtime environment values.

synthetic_credential_shape_exception.explanation: One passing XML testcase includes the public literal negative-test Mongo URI that deliberately exercises rejection of credentialed loopback URIs. It exactly matches the immutable source fixture; it is not an operational credential. Raw ZIP bytes remain unchanged.

scan_limit: Pattern review is supplemented by source-bound synthetic fixture flags and inspection of artifact/report scope. It is not a universal secret-detection guarantee.
independent_review: Integration reviewer independently inspected the 15 ZIPs (32 text entries, 39 XML entries inside XLSX and 29 PNGs) and selected generated metadata, and found no real credential material or credential-field candidates. PNGs contained no embedded metadata. Browser/fixture evidence declares synthetic_only. The backend origin is a fingerprint, not its plaintext value; the literal NODE_ENV contract matches B. The credential-shaped public negative-test fixture identified by the packager is separately recorded above. No edits, fetch, host or browser calls were performed by the integration review.
